Resolutions of 1947

22 resolutions, 27% unanimous. Founding and early Cold War.

  • 16 (1947) Approval of the statute of the Free Territory of Trieste, Italy
  • 17 (1947) Requesting postponement of the execution of persons sentenced by the Greek Government
  • 18 (1947) Regulation and reduction of armaments
  • 19 (1947) Incidents in the Corfu Channel
  • 20 (1947) International control of atomic energy
  • 21 (1947) The Trusteeship Agreement for the Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands
  • 22 (1947) Security Council resolution 22 (1947) [on incidents in the Corfu Channel)
  • 23 (1947) The Commission of Investigation established by Security Council resolution 15 (1946) on the Greek question
  • 24 (1947) Admission of Hungary to membership in the United Nations
  • 25 (1947) Referring to the Committee on the Admission of New Members the application of Italy to membership in the United Nations
  • 26 (1947) The provisional rules of procedure of the Security Council
  • 27 (1947) Calling upon the Netherlands and Indonesia to cease hostilities
  • 28 (1947) Appointment of a subcommittee of the representatives of the delegations which have submitted proposals on the Greek question
  • 29 (1947) Admission of Yemen and Pakistan to membership in the United Nations
  • 30 (1947) The cease-fire between Indonesia and the Netherlands
  • 31 (1947) The Security Council Committee of Good Offices on the Indonesian question
  • 32 (1947) Concerning continued military operations in Indonesia
  • 33 (1947) The provisional rules of procedure of the Security Council
  • 34 (1947) Removal of the Greek question from the list of matters of which the Council is seized
  • 35 (1947) Concerning the Committee of Good Offices on the Indonesian question
  • 36 (1947) An arrangement which will ensure the observance of the cease-fire in Indonesia
  • 37 (1947) Inclusion of revised rules in the provisional rules of procedure of the Security Council

Security Council Record is an independent record of every resolution, vote and veto of the United Nations Security Council since 1946. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the United Nations. For official documents, use the Security Council website and the UN Digital Library.

Built on the documentation of the Security Council, the CR-UNSC corpus (Fobbe, Gasbarri and Ridi, CC0), the UN machine-readable resolutions and the UNSC votes since 1946 database (Sciences Po Atelier de cartographie and GRAM, CC BY 4.0). Method and sources.
